notes: Legitimate source content must not be removed merely to force different titles into identical internal framing.
Internal title-screen or gameplay composition differences are content behavior and must not become per-title viewport policy.
Any core option capable of cropping or suppressing source borders must be explicitly qualified before production activation.
This qualification records Genesis compatibility with the reusable CLASSIC_4_3 display contract.
It does not make Genesis a READY production presentation policy.
The 1440x1080 Master safe envelope is a reusable containment envelope, not a forced emulator framebuffer size.
Concrete Genesis RetroArch viewport coordinates remain package-owned and unqualified until the physical geometry/runtime validation boundary.
Artwork must adapt to technically correct content; game content must not be cropped, stretched, or distorted merely to fill artwork.
No title, ROM, archive, or per-game geometry identity participates in this qualification.
Physical geometry is intentionally unset in A.3-N.5-A.
NES geometry must not be copied.
SNES geometry must not be copied.
Genesis geometry must be derived and validated in A.3-N.5-B before production activation.
